## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 67 captures during November 2022. Activity was completed at the site as planned, providing a basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total is reported separately from the quality findings below so that the volume of activity and the subsequent assessment results remain clear.

## Image quality

Graders identified 7 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 10.4 per cent of all captures. The recurring camera issues noted in the draft should continue to be logged with the service desk, supporting review of any equipment or operating problems that may affect image quality.

## Grading

There were 7 referable results. The median grading lag was 2. This result should be considered alongside the activity volume and the ungradable findings when reviewing site performance for November 2022. Continued monitoring of image quality and grading timeliness will help identify whether the reported issues persist and whether further operational action is required at Hill Counties Health Centre.
